record.dic_text:
07727 Showbab {sho-bawb'}

與 07726 同; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Shobab 4; 4

朔罷 = "叛逆的"
1) 大衛和拔示巴所生的兒子
2) 一位猶大人, 迦勒和阿蘇巴所生的兒子, 希斯崙的孫子 (#代上 2:18|)
record.edic_text:
07727 Showbab {sho-bawb'}

the same as 07726;; n pr m

AV - Shobab 4; 4

Shobab = "rebellious"
1) son of David by Bathsheba
2) a Judaite, son of Caleb by his wife Azubah and grandson of Hezron
